extras_mapping.meaning: Runs off the bat only (batter runs). Not team runs; excludes wides, byes, leg-byes, no-ball penalty and penalty runs.
extras_mapping.evidence: sum(runs) == Cricsheet batter runs: 1488/1504 innings, 747/759 matches agree; sum(runs) == Cricsheet innings total: 16/1504 innings, 4/759 matches agree (fails, as expected)

extras_mapping.meaning: Runs scored from the primary extra on the delivery (wide runs incl. the wide penalty, no-ball runs, byes, leg-byes, penalty).
extras_mapping.evidence: runs+extras1+extras2 == Cricsheet innings total: 1494/1504 innings, 753/759 matches agree; extras1+extras2 == Cricsheet extras: 1491/1504 innings, 749/759 matches agree; extras1 on wide rows == Cricsheet wides: 1498/1504 innings, 755/759 matches agree; byes: 1475/1504 innings, 732/759 matches agree; leg-byes: 1473/1504 innings, 731/759 matches agree

extras_mapping.meaning: NOT a run count. It is a category code that is redundant with extras_type: 6=None, 2=wide, 3=legbyes, 4=byes, 1=Overstep, 5=other, 7=Penalty (one code per extras_type, see audit JSON original_extras1_codes_by_extras_type).
extras_mapping.evidence: one-to-one code/type pairing: [['None', '6', 1], ['Overstep', '1', 1], ['Penalty', '7', 1], ['byes', '4', 1], ['legbyes', '3', 1], ['other', '5', 1], ['wide', '2', 1]]; runs+extras1+extras2 == Cricsheet total: 0/1504 innings, 0/759 matches agree

extras_mapping.meaning: Additional extra runs on the same delivery (seen on Overstep/other rows, e.g. byes or leg-byes run off a no-ball). The exact split between extras1 and extras2 is not validated; only their sum is.
extras_mapping.evidence: extras1+extras2 == Cricsheet extras: 1491/1504 innings, 749/759 matches agree

extras_mapping.meaning: Literal text 'None': no extra on the ball.
extras_mapping.evidence: 189167 rows in the original file carry extras_type 'None'; legal-ball rule below validated

extras_mapping.meaning: Wide. Not a legal ball. Batter runs are 0.
extras_mapping.evidence: legal-ball rule R2 excludes wides: 1497/1504 innings, 753/759 matches agree; extras1 == Cricsheet wides: 1498/1504 innings, 755/759 matches agree

extras_mapping.meaning: Leg-byes / byes. Legal ball; runs are extras1_runs (updated file).
extras_mapping.evidence: byes: 1475/1504 innings, 732/759 matches agree; leg-byes: 1473/1504 innings, 731/759 matches agree

extras_mapping.meaning: No-ball (overstep). Not a legal ball; batter runs on the ball are counted in `runs`.
extras_mapping.evidence: Overstep alone == Cricsheet noballs: 1290/1504 innings, 559/759 matches agree; Overstep+other == Cricsheet noballs: 1502/1504 innings, 757/759 matches agree; 529 Overstep rows in compared matches

extras_mapping.meaning: Behaves like a no-ball (not a legal ball, 1 extra run). The reason/label (e.g. free-hit or non-overstep no-ball) is not given in the data.
extras_mapping.evidence: legal rule excluding wide+Overstep+other == Cricsheet legal balls: 1497/1504 innings, 753/759 matches agree vs without 'other': 1285/1504 innings, 556/759 matches agree; 244 rows in compared matches
extras_mapping.status: VERIFIED as no-ball-like; label meaning UNVERIFIED

extras_mapping.meaning: Penalty runs (5 in the one observed row). Legal-ball status not determinable.
extras_mapping.evidence: 0 Penalty rows among Cricsheet-linked matches; 1 in the original file

extras_mapping.meaning: A delivery counts as a legal ball when extras_type is not wide, Overstep or other. Row count per innings, not innings_ball_num, is what to count.
extras_mapping.evidence: legal rows == Cricsheet legal balls: 1497/1504 innings, 753/759 matches agree; rows == Cricsheet deliveries: 1495/1504 innings, 753/759 matches agree
wicket rows == Cricsheet wickets: 1483/1504 innings, 740/759 matches agree

extras_mapping.meaning: Row counters, not legal-ball counters. innings_ball_num runs 1..n over every row of the innings (wides and no-balls included); over_ball_num runs 1..rows-in-over and so can exceed 6; overid is the 1-based over number. Count legal balls with the legal-delivery rule, not with these columns.
extras_mapping.evidence: innings with innings_ball_num exactly 1..n: 1724/1724; overs with over_ball_num exactly 1..rows: 32350/32350; max overid by innings: [[1, 20], [2, 20], [3, 1], [4, 1]]; innings 3 and 4 are super-over innings (rows by innings: [[1, 867, 105727], [2, 845, 95234], [3, 6, 25], [4, 6, 13]]; innings numbers 3/4 as super overs is consistent with 1-over max overid, UNVERIFIED against Cricsheet super_over flags)
extras_mapping.status: VERIFIED (internal consistency); super-over meaning of innings 3/4 UNVERIFIED

extras_mapping.evidence: 1504 innings / 759 matches linked to Cricsheet by date+teams

batting_stats2026.csv.check_note: Compared on exact player-name equality against official IPL 2026 matches that have ball-by-ball rows; names, not ids, because the stats file has no player_id.

ipl_cricsheet_vs_official_csv.note: Matching is by exact date and normalised team names only; no mapping tables are created in Phase 1.

ipl_squad.note: Candidates only: exact normalised name, else same surname + first initial. No identity is asserted; player_id remains the sole key.
